title: Lesson code block commands: safety_filter from chiku_control_cpp (the package in this lesson workspace) and teleop remapped into it

sol: ros2 run chiku_control_cpp safety_filter --ros-args -r cmd_vel_out:=/turtle1/cmd_vel -p max_speed:=1.0

/home/student/.bashrc.content:
# ~/.bashrc runs every time you open a new terminal
alias ll='ls -alF'

/home/student/ros2_ws/src/chiku_control_.content:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<package format="3">
  <name>chiku_control_cpp</name>
  <version>0.1.0</version>
  <description>Chiku's own nodes, written in C++</description>
  <maintainer email="student@todo.todo">student</maintainer>
  <license>Apache-2.0</license>

  <buildtool_depend>ament_cmake</buildtool_depend>

  <depend>rclcpp</depend>
  <depend>geometry_msgs</depend>
  <depend>turtlesim</depend>

  <export>
    <build_type>ament_cmake</build_type>
  </export>
</package>

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.8)
project(chiku_control_cpp)

if(CMAKE_COMPILER_IS_GNUCXX OR CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
  add_compile_options(-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
endif()

# 1. find every package the code #includes
find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
find_package(rclcpp REQUIRED)
find_package(geometry_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(turtlesim REQUIRED)

# 2. one executable per node: build it, link it, install it
add_executable(safety_filter src/safety_filter.cpp)
target_link_libraries(safety_filter rclcpp::rclcpp ${geometry_msgs_TARGETS} ${turtlesim_TARGETS})
install(TARGETS safety_filter DESTINATION lib/${PROJECT_NAME})

ament_package()
